title: ShoreFeel beach-water forecast backtest
method: NOAA LMHOFS t00z surface temperature (f000, f024, f048 at the node nearest each buoy) versus NDBC buoy water temperature. Forecast = buoy temperature at t0 + model change from t0 to t0+lead. Persistence = buoy temperature at t0.
caveats: Six weeks, four open-water buoys, one season of late-summer to early-fall weather.
No test yet against thermometers at the swim line, so the shallow-water adjustment is unvalidated.
No test yet in June to August heat.

coolingWatch.rule: model surface change over the next 24 h <= -1.5 F

warmingSkill: weak: the model signalled the right direction on about half of the 3 F-or-greater warm-ups, so no warming alert is shown
rangeRule: half-width = 1.5 x mean absolute error at that lead, rounded up (2 F through 24 h, 3 F at 36 to 48 h), plus 1 F when the shallow adjustment exceeds 0.5 F
